entities.summary: Denk, legally registered as Politieke Beweging Denk, is a political party in the Netherlands, founded on a platform catering to those from an immigrant and Muslim background. It is generally positioned towards the left-wing of the political spectrum and advocates for a tolerant, multicultural society although it also contains socially conservative attitudes among its members.
